name: NVIDIA Corporation
business_model: Fabless designer of data-center GPUs, networking and full rack-scale AI systems; wafers from TSMC/Samsung, HBM from SK hynix/Micron/Samsung, CoWoS packaging, assembly by contract manufacturers.

name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
business_model: Fabless designer of CPUs, GPUs and adaptive chips; Data Center segment combines EPYC server CPUs and Instinct AI GPUs.

name: Broadcom Inc.
business_model: Semiconductor solutions (incl. custom AI XPUs co-designed with hyperscalers and AI Ethernet switching) plus infrastructure software (VMware).

name: Marvell Technology, Inc.
business_model: Fabless data-infrastructure chip company; about three-quarters of revenue from data centre (custom ASICs, electro-optics, switching, storage).

name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
business_model: Pure-play foundry making wafers to customer designs, plus advanced packaging (CoWoS, SoIC); AI accelerators were a high-teens share of 2025 revenue.

name: SK hynix Inc.
business_model: Memory IDM (DRAM, NAND); leading HBM supplier to AI accelerator makers.

name: Micron Technology, Inc.
business_model: Memory IDM (DRAM, NAND, HBM) with HBM supplied under annual pricing agreements.

name: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.
business_model: Conglomerate whose Device Solutions division makes memory (incl. HBM), runs a foundry and designs System LSI chips; also a device OEM.

name: Amazon.com, Inc.
business_model: Cloud provider (AWS) that buys merchant GPUs and designs its own Trainium AI accelerators and Graviton CPUs.

name: Alphabet Inc.
business_model: Cloud and internet company that designs its own TPU AI accelerators, used internally and rented to cloud customers.
